player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.reaction-briliant.text: Salgótarján is intact. The Czechoslovak command has lost time recovering, so we can prepare the northern operation. Tell me what the factories must supply first.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.reaction-tactical.text: We have the mines. The formations need rest and replacements before we send them north. I can promise production; I can't promise those men another battle yet.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.reaction-victory.text: The industrial district is held. We may go north - carefully, and with the supply columns kept close behind the mobile formations.
line.callback-industry-held.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.callback-industry-held.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.callback-industry-held.text: The northern industrial belt held completely. Salgotarjan is still producing, and what it produces is reaching the front.
line.callback-industry-partial.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.callback-industry-partial.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.callback-industry-partial.text: We saved part of the industrial district. The output is a fraction of what it was, and the miners know exactly which pits we could not defend.
line.callback-workers.speaker: János Kovács
line.callback-workers.text: You sent us men who could train the companies. They held. The furnaces are working again, and the crews want me to tell you they remember the rifles arriving.
line.callback-workers-grudge.speaker: János Kovács
line.callback-workers-grudge.text: We took the rifles and held as long as we could. Some pits won't reopen. Before you thank us, tell me why the relief came after the furnaces went cold.
line.callback-kisterenye-vindicated.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.callback-kisterenye-vindicated.text: You backed my attack on the Kisterenye pincer. The road opened and the industrial belt held. Kovács still had to fight alone while we did it. I'll hear him out if he has a complaint.
line.callback-kisterenye-grudge.speaker: János Kovács
line.callback-kisterenye-grudge.text: You broke the pincer. We couldn't hold all the city until you arrived. Come and look at the pits we've lost before you tell the men the manoeuvre was necessary.
line.miskolc-rail-yard.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.miskolc-rail-yard.text: Salgótarján is sending shells north and bringing wounded men back. Miskolc's workshops and junction are next. Can you take them without cutting the line we need to supply you?
line.stromfeld-opening.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-opening.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-opening.text: Miskolc would give us the northern railway and workshops. I want them taken, but I also want formations left for the advance afterward. Landler, which approach costs us least?
line.landler-question.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-question.text: The garrison covers several approaches and will counterattack the moment one quarter falls. How do we take the city without feeding the new worker battalions into prepared streets—turn the position by cutting its northern roads, or strike every entrance before the defenders can concentrate?
line.landler-question.choice.turning-att: Fix the defenders in front while mobile units cut the northern roads and force an evacuation.
Gain a prestige award and experience for every core reconnaissance unit, but forgo the artillery detachment and near-full resupply.
line.landler-question.choice.concentric-: Attack from several directions at once, seize the stations, and prevent the garrison from concentrating.
Gain a mountain-artillery detachment and near-full core resupply, but forgo the turning attack's prestige and reconnaissance experience.
line.stromfeld-turning.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-turning.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-turning.text: Use the mobile force to threaten their communications. Keep pressure in front so the garrison cannot all turn against it. Report when the northern road is cut.
line.bohm-turning-objection.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.bohm-turning-objection.text: If the turning column stalls, the new worker battalions will face the garrison alone. I accept the order. I also want a time on the map when those battalions stop waiting and pull back.
line.landler-concentric.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-concentric.text: Then the attacks must be simultaneous. A piecemeal assault will feed inexperienced battalions into prepared positions one after another.
line.stromfeld-concentric-objection.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-concentric-objection.text: I'll write the timings. But a broken telephone could leave one column attacking alone. Every commander needs instructions for that before we begin, Landler.
line.bohm-warning.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.bohm-warning.text: The furnaces are still hot. Keep shellfire out of the works if you can, and leave men at the stations after they fall. I need a city that can repair this army tomorrow.
line.stromfeld-final.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-final.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-final.text: Take Miskolc without letting the garrison consume the attacking force. I want the command group and the northern road ready when Kassa becomes the next order.
